pinnedMathlibReuse.correction: LinearMap.IsPerfectCompl U V asserts that U complements the transported annihilator of V, and conversely. If U equals that annihilator, IsPerfectCompl would assert IsCompl U U, which is not the wanted global-duality relation. LinearMap.IsPerfPair.restrict is therefore not a shortcut from global orthogonality to Poitou-Tate. Use annihilator equality and quotient/dimension arguments; apply restrict only to actual complementary nondegenerate subspaces with its hypotheses proved.
